title: Security Culture Heatmap Portal
tagline: A culture analytics portal for visualizing maturity, norms, leadership signals, and risk-aware behaviors.

book.title: Artificial Intelligence for Security Culture Transformation
book.author: Musaab Hasan
book.alignment: Appendix A: Security Culture Assessment Tools
book.theme: Culture maturity, leadership modeling, social norms, assessment evidence, and heatmap-driven improvement.

dimensions.label: Leadership Modeling
dimensions.description: Measures visible secure behavior and sponsorship from leaders.

dimensions.label: Shared Responsibility
dimensions.description: Tracks whether security is treated as everyone's role.

dimensions.label: Psychological Safety
dimensions.description: Measures comfort reporting mistakes, concerns, and near misses.

dimensions.label: Security Norms
dimensions.description: Assesses whether secure behavior is socially reinforced.

dimensions.label: Learning Orientation
dimensions.description: Tracks post-incident learning and continuous improvement.

dimensions.label: Maturity Progression
dimensions.description: Measures movement across security culture maturity levels.

workflows: Assess culture dimensions by department or stakeholder group.
Generate heatmaps that highlight uneven maturity and hidden weak spots.
Prioritize interventions by cultural risk and business criticality.
Reassess quarterly and document movement with evidence.
evidence_examples: Assessment score movement with dated evidence.
Documented behavior observations from simulations or operational workflows.
Leadership review notes, action owners, and completed improvement tasks.
